name: @dsh-external/dotdsh-git-flow
description: dotdsh git-flow: the /git-start, /git-complete and /git-cleanup feature-branch workflow — a pre-write guard, a per-family claim that records which tree a session writes in, the bundled git-flow and git-master skills, and a worktree only for the sessions that have to move out of the main checkout
